differential.name: Essential hypertension
differential.rationale: Documented hypertension with obesity and stress, common primary cause of elevated blood pressure in this age group.

differential.name: Metabolic syndrome
differential.rationale: Presence of obesity (BMI >30), hypertension, low HDL, and borderline LDL fulfills ATP‑III criteria.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
differential.rationale: Obesity and hypertension in a middle‑aged adult raise high pre‑test probability for OSA.

differential.name: Chronic periodontitis (gingival disease)
differential.rationale: Recurrent gingivitis suggests ongoing periodontal inflammation, a known systemic risk factor.

differential.name: Primary dyslipidemia – isolated low HDL
differential.rationale: Low HDL with normal triglycerides and LDL points to a lipid disorder contributing to cardiovascular risk.
